sections.title: New
items: Added VRGDG Standalone Video Enhancer, a clean interface outside Video Builder for uploading an existing video, previewing effects, rendering, and saving the finished result.
Added Original, 2K, 3K, and 4K output choices using high-quality Lanczos resizing while preserving aspect ratio and portrait or landscape orientation.
Added Fast Unsharp Sharpen controls up to strength 10 and Fast Film Grain controls with intensity, saturation mix, and deterministic seed settings.

sections.title: Improved
items: Added current-frame and synchronized final-video before-and-after comparison with a draggable wipe slider and screen-filling expanded view.
Long videos render in memory-aware frame batches with checkpoint resume, cancellation, automatic GPU out-of-memory retry, and optional preservation of the original audio.

releases.title: Video comparison, global audio, and Builder performance

sections.title: New
items: Added VRGDG Video Compare Slider with synchronized before-and-after playback, a draggable comparison divider, timeline scrubbing, looping, labels, and optional audio.
Added a visual Storyboard subject picker for assigning one or more existing Reference Builder subjects to a scene or uploading a new subject.

sections.title: Improved
items: Increased Fast Unsharp Sharpen strength from a maximum of 2.0 to 10.0.
Improved Video Builder undo memory by deduplicating embedded media and recording inspector text edits once per edit session.
Added stable, versioned thumbnail URLs and immutable caching so scene thumbnails are not downloaded again on every render.
Storyboard imports now merge incoming subjects and locations with existing references instead of ignoring new references when mappings already exist.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Global audio now remains the preferred final soundtrack and fills scenes without custom audio during scene-audio preparation and stitching.
Loading or restoring global audio now correctly restores timeline playback and the visible waveform instead of remaining on silent scene audio.
The Video Builder menu now stays inside the viewport and scrolls so every menu action remains accessible.

releases.title: Lyric timing, Storyboard prompts, and scene merging

sections.title: New
items: Added right-click actions to merge a scene with its left or right neighbor while combining lyrics, notes, singers, and scene mappings without shifting surrounding scene timing.
Added a confirmation warning before transcription when reference lyrics contain parenthesized text that will be treated as sung or spoken lyrics.

sections.title: Improved
items: Wizard lyric scene creation now uses the same shared Create Scenes From Lines engine as Line Mapping.
Pasted lyric lines and stanzas remain intact even when their detected duration falls outside the minimum or maximum scene settings.
Exact reference-line mode keeps normal lyric alignment, instrumental-gap detection, vocal-tail padding, and boundary cleanup while ignoring only minimum and maximum duration limits.
Only [instrumental] and [instrumental break] force no-vocal sections; [intro], [outro], and [break] remain section headers because those sections may contain lyrics.
Wizard lyric output removes parenthesis characters after transcription while preserving the lyric words inside them.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Manual video prompts now render exactly as entered: typing, pasting, Prompt Options edits, reloads, and find/replace remain manual even after a later Gemma edit, while automatic trigger, vocal, facial-performance, and ID-LoRA prompt augmentation is limited to prompts originally created by Gemma.
Prevented final render preparation from appending the facial-performance direction a second time after it was already included in the generated video prompt.

Storyboard Video Prep now explicitly begins non-I2V prompts with the selected starting shot, including an extreme close-up for an eyes shot, and preserves that opening through the embedded Video Builder prompt path without changing ordinary I2V first-frame behavior.
Prevented stale inspector values from overwriting a different scene and creating blank, truncated, or 0.1-second scenes.
Improved unmatched reference-line timing so unaligned lyrics receive natural text-sized timing instead of stretching across large portions of the song.
Improved vocal-tail and shared-boundary cleanup to prevent lyric scenes from overlapping or being pushed away from their detected word starts.

releases.title: Builder navigation, update details, and reliability fixes

sections.title: New
items: Added Review Guide to the Builder menu for direct access to the public LTX 2.3 Video Builder guide.
Added a clear legacy notice before opening the older Prompt Creator workflow.
Added an optional What's New window so users can review release details from the status banner or Builder menu.

sections.title: Improved
items: New projects now open directly in Video Builder.
Prompt Creator is labeled as a legacy workflow, with Storyboard Builder recommended for new story planning.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Removed the obsolete Remake Mode menu item.
Fixed the update-status banner so it no longer stretches the toolbar or reduces the main workspace.
Fixed update detection for development builds whose changes were squash-merged to main.
Fixed ID-LoRA GGUF rendering so the unused safetensors loader is removed before ComfyUI validates the prompt.

releases.title: Expanded Storyboard and Browser AI guide

sections.title: Documentation
items: Added Storyboard Builder screenshots for the main window, Story Layer, Image Prep defaults, and Video Prep defaults.
Added Browser AI screenshots for provider setup, manual mode, and Band Sequence groups.
